entries.text: [Julie Andrews] Good evening, this is Julie Andrews.
[Julie Andrews] Once upon a time, there was a Magic Kingdom made of hopes and childhood fantasies.
[Julie Andrews] A timeless place, where every land was filled with wonder.
[Julie Andrews] A place where everyone who entered its gates
[Julie Andrews] Would be given the gift of the young at heart —
[Julie Andrews] The power to wish upon a star
[Julie Andrews] And unlock its magic.
[Julie Andrews] Are you ready to wish upon a star?
[Julie Andrews] Then it's time to open your heart and remember…
[Julie Andrews] dreams come true.
[Julie Andrews] In 1955, a magical place was born,
[Julie Andrews] And in this marvelous kingdom,
[Julie Andrews] There lived many delightful friends who made our dreams come true.
[Julie Andrews] An enchanting place where storybook heroes and daring adventures waited around every corner.
[Cinderella] I wish...I could go to the ball.
[Snow White] I'm wishing...someday, my prince will come.
[Ariel] Ha-ha. I wish...Ohh...I wish I could be part of that world
[Peter Pan] I wish...we'd never have to grow up! Off to Neverland ha-ha!
[Pinocchio] Know what, Jiminy, someday I wish I could be a real boy.
[Aladdin] Genie, I wish for your freedom.
[Julie Andrews] Tonight, we're going to share a wonderful dream come true together.
[Julie Andrews] In 1955, an amazing man named Walt Disney dreamt of a Magic Kingdom.
[Walt Disney] To all who come to this happy place, welcome!
[Walt Disney] Disneyland is your land.
[Walt Disney] Here age relives fond memories of the past,
[Walt Disney] And here youth may savor the challenge and promise of the future.
[Walt Disney] Disneyland is dedicated to the ideals, the dreams, and the hard facts that have created America,
[Walt Disney] With the hope that it will be a source of joy and inspiration for all the world.
[Conductor] Your attention, please!
[Conductor] The Disneyland Limited
[Conductor] Now leaving for a grand circle tour of the Magic Kingdom.
[Conductor] Board!
[José] Ole! Ole! It's showtime!
[José] ♫ All the birds sing words, ♫
[Michael] ♫ And the flowers croon, ♫
[Fritz] Mein goodness!
[Pierre] Mon ami!
[Michael] The gods have been angered by all the celebratin'!
[Sallah] As you enter the Chamber of Destiny, do not look into the eyes of the idol!
[Ghost Host] Welcome, foolish mortals, to the Haunted Mansion.
[Ghost Host] I am your host — your Ghost Host.
[Ghost Host] Is this haunted room actually stretching…
[Ghost Host] Or is it your imagination?
[Ghost Host] This chamber has no windows and no doors.
[Ghost Host] Which offers you this chilling challenge:
[Ghost Host] To find a way out!
[Ghost Host] Of course, there's always my way.
[Madame Leota] Serpents and spiders, tail of a rat,
[Madame Leota] Call in the spirits, wherever they're at!
[Madame Leota] Rap on a table — it's time to respond.
[Madame Leota] Let there be music from regions beyond!
[Little Leota] Hurry back.
[Little Leota] Hurry back.
[Little Leota] Be sure to bring your death certificate
[Pirate Captain] Strike yer colors, ya bloomin' cockroaches!
[Pirate Captain] Stand by at yer guns…
[Pirate Captain] Fire at will!
[Pirate Captain] Avast, ya scurvy scum!
[Pirate Captain] Pound 'em, lads! Pound 'em!
[Pirate Captain] Ay, that'll show the bilge rats!
[Pirate Captain] Another broadside, and ye goes down with the tide!
[Pirate Captain] Surrender, ya lily-livered lubbers!
[Pirate Captain] Run up yer white flag!
[Peter Pan] C'mon, everybody — here we go!
[Mad Hatter / March Hare] No room! No room! No vacancies! No room!
[Casey Jr.] All aboard! Let's go!
[Mad Hatter / March Hare] A very merry unbirthday to you!
[Benny The Cab] Holy smokes, Roger — we've been dipped!
[Max] Just lead the way, Henry!
[Buff] All right!
[Skunk] Wow, showbiz!
[Tigger] Follow the bouncin' Tigger! Hoo-hoo-hoo-hoo!
[Tigger] Right this way! Hoo-hoo-hoo-hoo!
[Jack Wagner] Remain seated, please.
[Jack Wagner] Permanecer sentados, por favor.
[Submarine Tech] Warning light, sir. We've reached maximum depth limit.
[Submarine Captain] Ease her back up to 80 fathoms.
[Submarine Tech] Eight zero fathoms, aye-aye!
[Julie Andrews] Today, Walt Disney's Magic Kingdom has grown to become the "Happiest Place on Earth" to millions the world over.
[Julie Andrews] A place where anything is possible —
[Julie Andrews] where every dreamer may wish upon a star.
[Julie Andrews] Remember… dreams come true.
